nations.name: Southern Ute Indian Tribe
nations.lands: Southern Ute Reservation around Ignacio, southwestern Colorado, United States

facts.text: Under a May 11, 2026 agreement with Interior, the Southern Ute Indian Tribe can approve covered energy and mineral leases, agreements and rights-of-way on its reservation trust lands.

source.title: Southern Ute Indian Tribe Celebrates Signing of Tribal Energy Resource Agreement

facts.evidence: approve energy- and mineral-related leases, agreements, and rights-of-way
